title: Asset Provenance Consumer Contract
description: Implementation-facing provenance subset. Keep field names and license-state semantics aligned with the generator-agnostic Asset Factory contract; this file does not supersede that contract.

asset_id.description: Stable identifier for the asset or asset family.

license_state.description: Only CLEARED assets may be treated as production-approved after all other review gates pass.

generator_model.description: Model/provider identifier when AI generation materially contributed to the asset.

license.description: Human-readable license or commercial-rights record when applicable.

notes.description: Processing history, material caveats, or additional provenance context.
